newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: WMC, TEPCO sign uranium deal.
newsitem.headline: WMC, TEPCO sign uranium deal.

text.p: Mining giant WMC Ltd said on Thursday it had signed a 10-year uranium supply contract with Tokyo Electric Power Co (TEPCO).
WMC said the contract for 1,000 short tons a year (907 metric tonnes) from 1999 was the largest uranium contract undertaken by its Olympic Dam operation in South Australia.
WMC expanded its Olympic Dam operations last year boosting copper capacity to 200,000 a year and uranium production to 4,630 tonnes a year from 3,700 annually.
Tokyo Electric Power Co is Japan's largest generator of nuclear electricity with a capacity of 15,952 megawatts.
